confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on several travel-blog, cost-of-living index and aggregator sources that differ by up to about two-fold. Bolivia changed its exchange-rate regime in mid-2026, so local prices may still be moving. Local-currency figures were converted at about 9.7 BOB per USD, based on reported late-June 2026 official trading. Beer, coffee, the inexpensive meal and the mid-range meal are the better-supported anchors. Cocktail was not directly sourced and is set at about twice the beer anchor using the local price relationship. Wine glass rests on a La Paz retail wine bottle price plus typical restaurant markup; no direct glass price was found. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and Uyuni's tour-town context. No accommodation searches or live listings were consulted, so they are the least reliable part of the estimate.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors reflect Bolivian national and La Paz/Trinidad aggregated prices plus Uyuni tourist-restaurant reports. Accommodation anchors reflect a holistic estimate for a remote, tour-driven highland town in southwest Bolivia.
